selection: Top two by best validation Macro-F1 in the five-epoch proxy; select by mean best validation Macro-F1 across reranking seeds. Exact ties use earlier trial ID. Final checkpoints selected on validation only.
protocol: GA optimizes hyperparameters; AdamW trains weights. Same search space, initial population, trial count, proxy/rerank/final epoch budgets for both architectures. No test access until both selected configurations and all final models are saved.
scope: Exploratory extension: test was already reported in the previous fixed-configuration experiment. One GA search seed per architecture; three final training seeds do not measure search variability. No claim that GA outperforms random search.
